name: findagent
description: Reviewed FindAgent agents, exported as plugins.

plugins.name: clay-animation-director
plugins.description: AI agent that turns your idea into a claymation shot list, locked clay character and stop-motion prompts for any AI video tool.

plugins.name: listing-asset-studio
plugins.description: Turns your agent's listing copy into a family-style logo and visual-first screenshots, as PNG. Every word and number comes from you.

plugins.name: marketing-ad-researcher
plugins.description: Ranks competitor ads by how long they stayed live and mines reviews for customer language. Gaps are reported, never guessed.

plugins.name: marketing-ad-scripter
plugins.description: Shot beats, continuity kits and generation prompts for every scene. Real proof gets filmed, never faked.

plugins.name: marketing-ad-tester
plugins.description: QA-checks your finished clips and sets up tests that change one thing at a time. No score without a measurement.

plugins.name: marketing-angle-strategist
plugins.description: Turns your research into a ranked list of ad angles, each scored out of 100 with the math shown and weak claims removed.

plugins.name: marketing-brief-scoper
plugins.description: Turns your landing page into a locked video ad brief, one question at a time. No invented prices, claims or audiences.

plugins.name: marketing-hook-writer
plugins.description: Hooks, proof and CTAs built from real customer quotes as mix-and-match pieces, so one shoot becomes many ad variants.

plugins.name: marketing-introgen-briefer
plugins.description: Turns approved ad creative into an IntroGen motion-graphics brief. Every claim checked, one production per approval.

plugins.name: marketing-production-planner
plugins.description: Turns your script pack into a costed production plan with work tracks and shoot briefs. Nothing gets spent without your approval.

plugins.name: mobile-app-planner
plugins.description: Turns a vague mobile feature request into a spec with a real scope boundary.

plugins.name: mobile-bug-investigator
plugins.description: Turns a fuzzy bug report into a scoped investigation and a planner brief.

plugins.name: mobile-campaign-video-creator
plugins.description: Plans an install ad that only claims what the product actually did.

plugins.name: mobile-code-reviewer
plugins.description: Reviews a mobile change with severities that still mean something.

plugins.name: mobile-feature-developer
plugins.description: The file-level plan you approve before anyone opens an editor.

plugins.name: mobile-intake-interviewer
plugins.description: Runs the intake interview one question at a time and freezes the brief.

plugins.name: mobile-knowledge-librarian
plugins.description: Keeps a team's written knowledge findable instead of merely large.

plugins.name: mobile-qa-tester
plugins.description: Finds what your change left untested, and the device cases nobody runs.

plugins.name: mobile-security-checker
plugins.description: Finds the security defects that pass a code review and a green build.

plugins.name: mobile-ux-designer
plugins.description: The design spec before the screen gets built: states, copy, accessibility.

plugins.name: photo-location-sleuth
plugins.description: Where was this photo taken? Metadata, visible clues and sun angle, with an evidence-capped radius, a reasoning ledger and privacy limits.

plugins.name: repo-health-check
plugins.description: A transparent 0-100 health score for any public GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket repo, with the formula behind every finding.

plugins.name: social-content-director
plugins.description: Turn one idea into a ready-to-shoot Reel, TikTok or Short: hooks, scene-by-scene script, sound and caption.

plugins.name: webpage-xray
plugins.description: X-ray any page: SEO, accessibility, security, speed, UX, AI-search readiness and the hidden issues nobody checks

plugins.name: yc-pitch-deck-agent
plugins.description: Turns startup facts into a YC-style 10-slide deck spec and review; the PPTX is built by your client's PPTX skill. Never invents numbers.
